description.value: Persephone Brewing Company is a certified B Corp farm brewery in Gibsons on BC's Sunshine Coast, operating a working 5-acre property with barley fields, apple orchards, market gardens, and a flock of laying hens. The tasting room pours award-winning craft beer, cider, and hard seltzer alongside a kitchen menu, with outdoor picnic seating set amid the farmland. The brewery has earned 15+ awards including a Land Award from the Real Estate Foundation and is a B Corp 'Best for the World' honouree.

The site describes a working farm brewery with tasting room, outdoor picnic areas, and an on-site kitchen. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the fetched content; OSM shop=alcohol and website references to growler fills and cans/bottles confirm takeout beverage sales.
